strings.name: Gina Rinehart
strings.summary: Raised in the Pilbara, Rinehart entered her family business after leaving university and took charge in 1992. She developed Hope Downs and Roy Hill with partners and expanded agriculture. Her career also includes trust litigation, media investments and regulatory disputes. In a 2026 interview she discussed project development and criticized burdens on mining.
